proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F _ _ _ _ _ T S x a hT hx
  have hb : ∀ v, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n, ‖T n v‖ ≤ C := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hT v).norm.isBoundedUnder_le.bddAbove_range
    exact ⟨C, fun n => hC ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := banach_steinhaus hb
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T n (x n) - T n a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun n => M * ‖x n - a‖)
    · intro n
      rw [← map_sub]
      exact ((T n).le_opNorm _).trans (by gcongr; exact hM n)
    · have := ((hx.sub_const a).norm).const_mul M
      simpa using this
  have := h1.add (hT a)
  simpa using this
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (T : ℕ → E →L[𝕜] F) (S : E →L[𝕜] F) (x : ℕ → E) (a : E), (∀ v, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T n v) Filter.atTop (nhds (S v))) → Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds a) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T n (x n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (S a))
